proves.claim: a slow write's counter row and violation row both carry an at epoch-ms field.

store.io-board-write-lock.hold-rows-carr.why: Without this case a status reader could not tell recent holds from old ones.

proves.claim: the alarm reader counts counter rows inside the window with the worst move and heldMs, ignoring older rows and rows with no at.

store.io-board-write-lock.hold-alarm-rea.why: Without this case an old log would keep the alarm raised or older rows without a time would be counted.

proves.claim: the alarm reads only the last 64 KiB of a larger log and reports truncated when the window reaches past that tail.

store.io-board-write-lock.hold-alarm-bou.why: Without this case status would read the whole ever-growing log on each call.
